_about: Corrections applied on top of OpenStreetMap places, keyed by place id (osm-<type>-<id>). Use when OSM has a wrong or dead link; better still, also fix it on openstreetmap.org.

osm-node-14019328709._why: Oregon Korean War Memorial Interpretive Center: OSM's wilsonvilleparksandrec.com link is dead (owner, Nov 2026)

osm-node-13389810724._why: Crazy Jumpers: OSM's link is the mall's store directory, so its picture would be the mall's logo
